title: Visual Sanad: Auditing Vision–Language Models for False Acceptance of Qur’anic Citations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the false acceptance rate of incorrect text attributions across different visual conditions (e.g., plain text, decorative backgrounds, and institutional authority headers) to see if visual framing alters model factuality.

Evaluating whether vision-language models over-trust and falsely validate incorrect Qur'anic verse attributions when presented with culturally specific visual cues, such as Islamic-style decorative layouts or religious verification headers.
